title: Junie — Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: Coding Agent · IDE · CLI · Headless CI/CD

rows.label: Install (macOS/Linux)
rows.value: Run curl -fsSL https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | bash

rows.label: Install (Windows)
rows.value: Run iex (irm 'https://junie.jetbrains.com/install.ps1') in PowerShell

rows.label: Install (npm)
rows.value: npm install -g @jetbrains/junie

rows.label: Install (Homebrew)
rows.value: brew install jetbrains/junie/junie

rows.label: Launch
rows.value: Run junie from your project root — starts interactive TUI

rows.label: Check version
rows.value: junie --version

rows.label: Auth options
rows.value: JetBrains Account · Junie API key (JUNIE_API_KEY) · BYOK · Custom LLM

rows.label: Generate API key
rows.value: Visit junie.jetbrains.com/cli to create a JUNIE_API_KEY

rows.label: First prompt
rows.value: Type a task in the TUI; use @ to attach files, / for commands

rows.label: /local
rows.value: Junie Local: on-device Apple Silicon inference (Qwen3.6-27B-4bit); no cloud needed

rows.label: /demo
rows.value: EAP: launch disposable Docker VM, drive UI via Computer Use, export MP4 + HTML report

rows.label: /goal
rows.value: Orchestrated step-by-step mode; /goal stop to exit; optional [message] to start

rows.label: /loops
rows.value: Manage recurring scheduled tasks; aliases /crons, /cron-jobs

rows.label: /agent-mode
rows.value: Choose Classic or Chat mode; locked after first prompt; also --agent-mode flag

rows.label: /voice
rows.value: Record microphone input as a prompt; aliases /mic, /record

rows.label: Android (EAP)
rows.value: Install android-engineer extension via /extensions for emulator, Compose preview & QA subagent

rows.label: Custom Proxies
rows.value: Nightly: proxies array in config.json; select active proxy with --provider flag

rows.label: Hooks (EAP)
rows.value: Shell hooks on SessionStart, PreToolUse, Stop, PermissionRequest, SessionEnd

rows.label: Agent loop
rows.value: Prompt → Plan → Edits → Commands → Verification → Summary — fully autonomous

rows.label: @-attach files
rows.value: Type @filename or drag-drop a file/image into the TUI to add it to prompt context

rows.label: Image inputs
rows.value: Drag-drop or reference PNG/JPEG screenshots or design specs; Junie reads image content

rows.label: Good task shape
rows.value: Bounded, single-concern tasks with explicit acceptance criteria produce best results

rows.label: Follow-ups
rows.value: Type follow-ups while Junie is working; clarifications are appended and actioned immediately

rows.label: Shell passthrough
rows.value: Prefix ! to run a shell command without leaving the TUI, e.g. !git log --oneline

rows.label: Rollback
rows.value: Decline changes in the Done panel to revert all edits from the completed task

rows.label: Symbol @-complete
rows.value: With JetBrains IDE connected, @ suggests classes & symbols from IDE project index

rows.label: Toggle Plan mode
rows.value: Shift+Tab cycles default → Plan → Debug; or run /plan

rows.label: /plan <prompt>
rows.value: Enable Plan mode and submit prompt immediately, e.g. /plan refactor commands

rows.label: --plan flag
rows.value: junie --plan or junie --prompt "…" --plan to start directly in Plan mode

rows.label: Plan view
rows.value: Press Ctrl+P to open tabbed plan view: Requirements, Technical Design, Testing, Delivery

rows.label: Confirm & implement
rows.value: After reviewing the plan, choose Confirm and implement to let Junie proceed

rows.label: Save plan
rows.value: Choose Save the plan and stop to write plan Markdown to disk without implementing

rows.label: Iterate plan
rows.value: Push back in the chat before confirming; plan is updated as a living design document

rows.label: /goal [message]
rows.value: Orchestrated mode: Junie auto-plans milestones; /goal stop leaves orchestrated mode

rows.label: Discovery order
rows.value: 1) .junie/AGENTS.md (exclusive) 2) root AGENTS.md + .junie/playbook.md + .junie/rules/*.md 3) .junie/guidelines.md

rows.label: Global guidelines
rows.value: ~/.junie/AGENTS.md applies to all projects; project guidelines take precedence on conflict

rows.label: config.json location
rows.value: User: ~/.junie/config.json · Project: <root>/.junie/config.json

rows.label: --config-location
rows.value: Load extra config files: junie --config-location /path/cfg.json (can repeat)

rows.label: Key config fields
rows.value: model, effort, provider, brave, proxies, skill-locations, hooks

rows.label: JUNIE_GUIDELINES_FILENAME
rows.value: Env var or --guidelines-filename to override the default guidelines file

rows.label: .aiignore
rows.value: Create .aiignore in project root (gitignore syntax) to require approval before accessing listed files

rows.label: /project-onboarding
rows.value: Analyze project and suggest improvements to help the agent work more effectively

rows.label: Skills location
rows.value: Project: .junie/skills/<name>/SKILL.md · User: ~/.junie/skills/<name>/

rows.label: SKILL.md format
rows.value: YAML frontmatter with name (required) & description + Markdown body instructions

rows.label: Invoke a skill
rows.value: Auto-selected by relevance; explicit: /<skill-name> or $<skill-name> in prompt

rows.label: /skills
rows.value: List, enable, or disable skills; /skills <name> enable|disable in ACP mode

rows.label: Custom slash commands
rows.value: Create in .junie/commands/ (project) or ~/.junie/commands/ (user) as Markdown + YAML

rows.label: $argumentName
rows.value: Use $arg in command prompt template; Tab autocompletes missing args on invocation

rows.label: /import
rows.value: Import guidelines, skills, commands, or MCP configs from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex

rows.label: Custom subagents
rows.value: Add .junie/agents/<name>.md with YAML frontmatter (tools, model, skills, etc.)

rows.label: Slash commands
rows.value: Type / in the TUI to open the full command suggestion menu

rows.label: Shortcuts help
rows.value: Type ? in the TUI to see all available keyboard shortcuts

rows.label: Prompt history
rows.value: Ctrl+R to search history; navigate results with Up/Down arrow keys

rows.label: Transcript view
rows.value: Ctrl+O opens the session transcript (continuously updated transcript.md)

rows.label: Subagent tasks
rows.value: Ctrl+T opens the subagent tasks panel during a multi-agent session

rows.label: Scroll to bottom
rows.value: Ctrl+S scrolls to the latest output in the conversation

rows.label: /compress
rows.value: Compress context before the next task to reduce token use; alias /compact

rows.label: /logs
rows.value: Export session logs as a ZIP archive for bug reports; alias /export-logs

rows.label: /review
rows.value: Local code review wizard: From Main, Last Commit, or Unstaged Changes

rows.label: /review <instructions>
rows.value: Add custom scope: /review focusing on performance and memory leaks

rows.label: --review flag
rows.value: Headless review: junie --review or junie --review "Check for null pointers"

rows.label: [CRITICAL] label
rows.value: Security, crashes, data-loss findings are prefixed [CRITICAL]; accept or dismiss per finding

rows.label: Inline suggestions
rows.value: When a fix is safe, Junie includes a ready-to-apply code suggestion alongside each finding

rows.label: /pull-request
rows.value: Review a GitHub/GitLab PR from the CLI; alias /pr; optional [pr] argument

rows.label: Diff viewer (IDE)
rows.value: File links in the IDE tool window open side-by-side diff viewer for every changed file

rows.label: Human sign-off
rows.value: Keep humans in the PR/MR approval path for production changes — Junie helps, not decides

rows.label: /model
rows.value: Pick primary LLM and reasoning effort; Default = best price-quality ratio, dynamically set

rows.label: /effort
rows.value: Change only the effort level for the current model: minimal · low · medium · high · max

rows.label: /local
rows.value: Install Junie Local (Apple Silicon, macOS 26+, M5+, 64 GB RAM, ~21 GB disk)

rows.label: BYOK providers
rows.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, OpenRouter, GitHub Copilot — configure via /account

rows.label: GitHub Copilot BYOK
rows.value: Reuses local Copilot CLI sign-in (v1.0.65+); no separate API key required

rows.label: LiteLLM / Ollama / LM Studio
rows.value: /account → Custom models and endpoints; Junie auto-discovers models from the proxy

rows.label: Custom JSON profiles
rows.value: Place *.json in $JUNIE_HOME/models/; select with --model custom:<profile-name>

rows.label: /stats
rows.value: Session token usage, model costs, code changes & remaining balance; aliases /usage /cost

rows.label: /mcp
rows.value: List, add, enable/disable, and OAuth-authorize MCP servers; config in mcp.json

rows.label: mcp.json locations
rows.value: Project: .junie/mcp/mcp.json · User: ~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json

rows.label: --mcp-location
rows.value: Add extra MCP discovery folder: junie --mcp-location /path/to/mcp

rows.label: MCP tool limit
rows.value: Junie supports a maximum of 100 tools across all configured MCP servers

rows.label: /extensions
rows.value: Browse JetBrains marketplace; install bundles of skills + MCP + subagents + commands

rows.label: Extension scopes
rows.value: Project: stored in .junie/extensions.json · User: ~/.junie/extensions/extensions.json

rows.label: Custom marketplace
rows.value: /extensions marketplace add <github-owner/repo> to register a custom extension source

rows.label: IDE MCP Settings
rows.value: Settings | Tools | Junie | MCP Settings to add servers and check connection status

rows.label: /demo
rows.value: EAP: prompts for scope (branch diff, last commit, session changes, smoke test, or custom)

rows.label: Prerequisites
rows.value: Docker running + Computer Use model (GPT-5.4/5.5/5.6 SOL) + .junie/vms/Dockerfile

rows.label: demo.md
rows.value: Create .junie/demo.md with vm: <name> and build/launch commands for the VM

rows.label: Base image
rows.value: FROM registry.jetbrains.team/p/junie-cli/containers/demo-base:2 — ships Chromium, xvfb, ffmpeg

rows.label: Output artifacts
rows.value: Saved to ~/.junie/sessions/<id>/demo/: screenshots, demo.mp4, report.html

rows.label: First-run setup
rows.value: If demo.md or VM Dockerfile missing, Junie seeds starters and offers to fill them in

rows.label: Stop demo
rows.value: Press Esc while Working… is visible; VM shuts down cleanly

rows.label: Mounts file
rows.value: Optional .junie/vms/<name>/mounts for extra bind mounts: $HOME/.config/app:/root/.config:ro

rows.label: Basic headless run
rows.value: junie --auth="$JUNIE_API_KEY" "Fix failing tests"

rows.label: --task flag
rows.value: junie --task "Review and fix code quality" — alternative to positional argument

rows.label: --prompt flag
rows.value: Open interactive TUI with prompt pre-submitted; session stays interactive after completion

rows.label: --review flag
rows.value: Headless code review; combinable with a natural-language description

rows.label: --plan flag
rows.value: Start directly in Plan mode; combine with --prompt to auto-submit

rows.label: JUNIE_TASK env var
rows.value: Set JUNIE_TASK instead of passing the positional argument for CI pipelines

rows.label: Project trust
rows.value: Non-interactive runs are auto-trusted and load project config, MCP, skills, & hooks

rows.label: --help
rows.value: Run junie --help for the full list of flags and options

rows.label: Action reference
rows.value: uses: JetBrains/junie-github-action@v1 — runs entirely on your GitHub runners

rows.label: @junie-agent trigger
rows.value: Mention @junie-agent in an issue/PR comment or PR review to start a task

rows.label: code-review prompt
rows.value: Set prompt: "code-review" to auto-review PRs and post inline suggestions

rows.label: use_single_comment
rows.value: use_single_comment: true updates the same comment on each subsequent run

rows.label: resolve_conflicts
rows.value: resolve_conflicts: true auto-detects and resolves merge conflicts in open PRs

rows.label: silent_mode
rows.value: silent_mode: true suppresses comments; fails CI if issues found (secret audit use-case)

rows.label: allowed_mcp_servers
rows.value: Comma-separated list: e.g. allowed_mcp_servers: "mcp_github_checks_server"

rows.label: YouTrack integration
rows.value: Install Junie YouTrack app; set youtrack_token secret; triggers from issue widget or @junie

rows.label: #junie trigger
rows.value: Tag #junie in an issue or MR comment to invoke Junie in that project

rows.label: GITLAB_TOKEN_FOR_JUNIE
rows.value: Personal or group access token with Maintainer role & api scope required

rows.label: JUNIE_API_KEY (GitLab)
rows.value: Add to CI/CD Variables; or use BYOK keys like JUNIE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

rows.label: Init pipeline
rows.value: Run init pipeline with PROJECTS_TO_INIT var to wire webhooks & access tokens per project

rows.label: Auto MR review
rows.value: Junie reviews every opened MR automatically using the default or custom JUNIE_CUSTOM_PROMPT

rows.label: Disable auto-review
rows.value: Uncheck Merge request events in the Junie webhook settings to disable automatic reviews

rows.label: Follow-up iterations
rows.value: Tag #junie in a comment to a Junie-created MR to have it iterate on the task

rows.label: Self-managed support
rows.value: Works with GitLab.com SaaS and self-managed GitLab instances — same setup steps

rows.label: Plugin ID
rows.value: Install plugin 26104 (JetBrains Junie) from Marketplace; min IDE version 2024.3.2

rows.label: Recommended path
rows.value: Open AI Chat → select Junie by JetBrains; plugin downloaded automatically

rows.label: Supported IDEs
rows.value: IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, CLion, RustRover, RubyMine, Android Studio

rows.label: Code / Ask modes
rows.value: Code: edits files & runs commands. Ask: read-only analysis & planning. Auto: self-selects

rows.label: /debug
rows.value: Toggle Debug mode: breakpoints, runtime state, expression eval against live JetBrains debugger

rows.label: /ide
rows.value: Inspect JetBrains IDE connection state; lists running IDEs, statuses, and lets you switch

rows.label: IDE Models page
rows.value: Settings | Tools | Junie | Models to pick the primary LLM in the IDE plugin

rows.label: IDE min version (CLion/Rider)
rows.value: CLion & Rider require IDE version 2025.2.1 or later for the Junie plugin

rows.label: /new [prompt]
rows.value: Start another live session; current session stays in background. /new fix tests pre-fills prompt

rows.label: /history
rows.value: Search & switch sessions; press Tab to filter to current project directory only

rows.label: Session resume
rows.value: junie --resume or junie --session-id <id> to reload a saved session

rows.label: /branch [name]
rows.value: Copy current conversation into a new session and switch to it with an optional title

rows.label: /title [name]
rows.value: Set session title; persists across reloads; shown in /history & terminal window title; alias /rename

rows.label: /worktree
rows.value: Create or switch to a Git worktree for parallel isolated file changes per session

rows.label: /remote
rows.value: Share the running CLI session via tunnel to junie.jetbrains.com/remote; requires JB Account or API key

rows.label: /copy [N]
rows.value: Copy latest (or Nth-latest) assistant response to clipboard; useful for sharing output

rows.label: Action Allowlist (IDE)
rows.value: Settings | Tools | Junie | Action Allowlist: manage terminal, MCP, build, read/write rules

rows.label: allowlist.json (CLI)
rows.value: Edit ~/.junie/allowlist.json with executables, fileEditing, mcpTools, readOutsideProject rules

rows.label: Rule syntax
rows.value: Each rule: prefix (literal start) or pattern (glob) + action: allow|ask; first match wins

rows.label: Check Command
rows.value: Use the Check Command button in IDE Allowlist settings to test if a command is covered

rows.label: Brave mode (CLI)
rows.value: /brave or Ctrl+B cycles: Off (ask all) → Auto (smart classify) → On (no asks)

rows.label: Brave mode (IDE)
rows.value: Enable Brave Mode checkbox in the task window; prefer Allowlist rules over Brave mode

rows.label: Project trust
rows.value: Untrusted projects skip config, MCP, hooks, agents, & skills; always review external skills

rows.label: BYOK privacy
rows.value: BYOK keys send requests directly to the provider; all billing goes to the provider, not JetBrains

rows.label: Start bounded
rows.value: Delegate single-concern tasks with explicit outputs — broad tasks need explicit sub-goals

rows.label: Ask for a plan first
rows.value: For complex work, use Shift+Tab to enter Plan mode before the first implementation prompt

rows.label: Validate explicitly
rows.value: Include expected test commands and outcomes in your prompt so Junie can verify its own work

rows.label: Use skills for patterns
rows.value: Codify naming conventions, test structure, and review rules as .junie/skills/ so they apply automatically

rows.label: Pin model versions
rows.value: Use specific model aliases like sonnet or opus in CI to avoid behavior drift from Default

rows.label: Scope guidelines per env
rows.value: Use junie_guidelines_filename in GitHub Action to override guidelines for CI without touching local config

rows.label: Pre-create worktrees
rows.value: Create worktrees before parallel tasks so build caches are warm and ready to go

rows.label: Updated
rows.value: Docs scraped 2026-09-01 — CLI & action details are version-sensitive; always check the latest docs
